about_the_game:
Yurei Hunt is a multiplayer prop hunt game where roles of hunter and spirit shift unexpectedly each match. One moment you may be tracking supernatural Yurei; the next, you’ll be hiding in plain sight as one of them. Each round is a tense battle of wits, deception, and quick thinking.

Explore diverse maps inspired by eerie traditional Japanese settings and futuristic cyberpunk environments. From cursed shrines to neon-soaked cityscapes, every location is filled with opportunities to outsmart your opponents. Hunters must seek out disguised Yurei before time runs out, while Yurei use special abilities to manipulate their surroundings and evade capture.

Matches are fast-paced and unpredictable, keeping every game fresh and thrilling.

Key Features

  • Dynamic Role Switching: Roles change randomly each match, keeping the gameplay fresh and engaging.

  • Diverse Maps: Navigate unique environments, from haunting shrines and forests to sprawling cyberpunk cities.

  • Tactical Gameplay: Yurei use powers and deception to survive, while hunters rely on observation and strategy.

  • Multiplayer Fun: Play with up to 10 players, competing with friends or online opponents.

  • Advanced Graphics & Performance: Built with Unreal Engine's latest graphics technology and enhanced by Nvidia DLSS for smoother, high-performance gameplay.

Will you become the hunter or the hunted? Wishlist Yurei Hunt today and experience a world of suspense and supernatural tricks!

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 8th Gen intel core i5
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 11th Gen intel core i5
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3050
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: Hunters and Yurei battle in a deadly game of hide-and-seek. Yurei disguise themselves and use ghostly powers to evade capture, while hunters rely on sharp instincts to track them. Explore eerie shrines, haunted forests, and neon-lit cyberpunk cities in this tense multiplayer prop hunt experience!
